this sign means it connects to another system usually monitor and control, in gelliceaux's case the Onyx. and it gives the Terminal strip and the terminal so XA 50 is the T/S and the arrow shaped rectangle is the terminal. if the arrow is pointing away from the system as in the case for XA50 01, XA50 02 and XA50 03 it means it measures a signal from the system, if the arrow is pointing toward the electrical system as in the case of XA21 16 it means it gives a control signal to it
typed_symbols.verify_what: read the ARROW DIRECTION: pointing away from the circuit = monitoring MEASURES it (indication); pointing toward the circuit = monitoring COMMANDS it (control)
